items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: And fellas like Freddie Coleman and Louis and so many other good drummers.

ctx.x: That's going to back you up instead of them trying to back themselves up. And he said, you'll find a lot of flash through the younger musicians, but they won't play what you want them to play. Mm-hmm. And during that time, so many bands, young musicians began to stretch out from Dixieland. See? They would just like a takeoff from it. They'd play everything. But basically, they had to come right back to Dixieland because the beat had to be there. But then they, when we were playing four beats to the measure, a lot…
